points.roles: Each player starts with 500 chips, and the players swap their roles each game: each one is the croupier 5 times.
points.sealed: The ball is sealed: no one, not even the server, sees the pocket of the ball before the punter bet.
points.talk: The two players talk in a conversation of their own, read by the whole room: the croupier may say anything about the ball, true or false.

presentation.rooms: Create a room, or join one, to play with others.
presentation.summary: A game of the manga Liar Game: 2 players face each other on a wheel of 4 pockets that never spins, over 10 games. In each game, the croupier places the ball and bets first, then the punter bets, reading the bets of the croupier.
presentation.tagline: A roulette that does not spin: the croupier knows where the ball lies.
presentation.title: Fixed roulette

end.games: The match is over after 10 games, or at once when a player has no chip left after a game: it loses.
end.title: The end of the match
end.winner: The player with the most chips wins; equal chips make a draw, two players out of chips at once included. The chips the bank took are lost to both.

fair.draw: No one picks the first croupier: each player gives a sealed random part at the start, and the croupier is drawn from both, the same on every page.
fair.order: A bet out of its turn is ignored by every page; a bet of the other player, or beyond the rules, is reported.
fair.sealed: The ball is sealed: the page of the croupier sends its hash with a random salt, along with its bets, then reveals it once the punter bet. No one, not even the server, sees the ball before. A page reloaded keeps its ball, unless its storage is blocked.
fair.title: Fair play

game.bet: Then the punter bets, seeing the bets of the croupier: on 2 pockets at most, as many chips as the croupier at least, or every chip it holds when it holds fewer.
game.place: The croupier places the ball in one of the 4 pockets, sealed, and bets in public at the same time: 1 chip at least, on 1 to 4 pockets, never more chips than it holds.
game.reveal: Then the page of the croupier reveals the ball by itself, and the chips are settled.
game.talk: Anyone may say anything about the ball, true or false, in the conversation of the players: the whole room reads it, only the players write in it.
game.title: A game

missed.bet: A punter who does not bet in time loses the match.
missed.place: A croupier who does not place the ball and bet in time loses the match.
missed.reveal: A croupier whose page does not reveal the ball within 15 seconds, reveals another ball than the one sealed, or a ball off the wheel, loses the match.
missed.title: Out of time
missed.void: The bets of the game then go back to their owners, and the other player wins the match, whatever the chips.

bank.losing: To the bank: every chip bet is lost

both.losing: Shared in the ratio of their chips on the ball, each share rounded down, the chip left over to the punter

settlement.caption: Where the chips of the other pockets go, depending on who bet on the pocket of the ball
settlement.example: For example, the croupier bets 15 chips on pocket 2 and 50 on pocket 3, the punter 35 on pocket 2 and 30 on pocket 4. The ball lies in pocket 2: both players take back their chips on it and share the 80 chips of the other pockets, 15 to 35. The croupier receives 24 chips and loses 50, −26; the punter receives 56 and loses 30, +26.
settlement.leftover: The shares rounded down leave one chip at most: with 10 chips of the croupier and 20 of the punter on the ball, the 5 chips to share give the croupier 1, the punter 3 and the chip left over, 4.
settlement.losing: The chips of the other pockets
settlement.text: The chips bet on the pocket of the ball go back to their owners. The chips of the other pockets go:
settlement.title: The settlement

setup.match: Each player starts with 500 chips. The match lasts 10 games, the players swapping their roles each game: the first croupier is drawn, then each player is the croupier 5 times.
setup.players: 2 players take the seats, the other participants watch. One of the players starts the match and picks the time of the bets, from 30 seconds to 5 minutes: the seats stay taken until it is over.
setup.title: The table

times.away: A player away is waited for 15 seconds more, once.
times.phases: The croupier and the punter each bet within the time picked at the start, the reveal waits 15 seconds: each phase closes as soon as its player acted.
times.title: The times
